subject: CFA with ordinal data: Weight Matrix and Test statistics

messages.author: 369782b9e254d3c8
messages.subject: CFA with ordinal data: Weight Matrix and Test statistics
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to fit a 3-factor CFA model to ordinal data with 2,3 and 5 categories through weighted least squares(WLS). However, the weight matrix provided by lavaan:

model <-' F1 =~ V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5
    F2 =~ V6 + V7 + V8 + V9 + V10
F3 =~ V11 + V12 + V13 + V14 + V15 '
fit <- cfa(model, data=data.G, ordered=names(data.G), std.lv = TRUE, estimator='WLS', se="robust.sem", test="satorra.bentler")
lavTech(fit,'wls.v')

does not match my results by estimating equations. Does anyone have the document of the formulas used in computing the weight matrix?

Updates: I went on to look over the source code and found Lavaan used the approach in Muthen(1984) to estimate the weight matrix. If anyone is familiar with that paper, its A11 is a block diagonal matrix while mine is always a diagonal matrix. 

My second question is about the satorra-bentler's rescaled test statistic. When the underlying distribution is multivariate normal and the sample size is very large (N>3000), the type I error rate of the statistic is still above 10% for ordinal data in my simulation study. Does it make sense? Shouldn't it be well controlled at 5%? Is it related to factor loadings (my largest loading is 0.9)?

Any help is appreciated,

Gabriella
